item.text: {"primary_intent":"adapt","brief_class":"brand_campaign","execution_status":"not_executed","workflow_steps":[{"id":"intake_brief","objective":"Confirm business goals, advisor and client audience segments, launch scope, parent-brand requirements, languages, channels, success measures, approvals and supplied materials."},{"id":"research","objective":"Review audience needs, existing program perceptions, advisor adoption barriers, competitor positioning and linguistic or cultural considerations for English, French and selected Chinese-language materials."},{"id":"principles","objective":"Establish positioning, messaging, accessibility, localization and parent-brand alignment principles to guide the campaign system."},{"id":"structure_spec","objective":"Define the persona-to-message matrix, content hierarchy, channel and format inventory, language variants and specifications for print and digital communications."},{"id":"explore_concepts","objective":"Develop meaningfully different campaign and rebrand directions that connect the managed-portfolios offer to the parent brand."},{"id":"select_direction","objective":"Compare directions against strategic, audience, bilingual, cultural and brand criteria and obtain explicit client approval of one direction."},{"id":"refine","objective":"Apply stakeholder, advisor, legal, compliance and localization feedback while preserving the approved strategic direction."},{"id":"identity_system","objective":"Document the approved program relationship to the parent identity, including naming, marks, typography, colour, imagery, graphic devices and governance rules."},{"id":"expand_assets","objective":"Extend the approved system across persona-led advisor and client communications in English, French and the agreed Chinese-language print subset."},{"id":"production_file","objective":"Prepare technically valid digital and print masters with approved copy, translations, accessibility requirements and production specifications."},{"id":"deliver","objective":"Validate completeness, language versions, brand consistency, compliance approvals and file integrity before packaging and handing off final assets."}],"reference_observations":[],"deliverable_concepts":["brand_strategy","logo_system","visual_identity","campaign_key_visual","brand_applications","production_spec","mockups"],"missing_inputs":["Parent-brand guidelines, approved logos, templates and source files","Current program identity, communications, performance evidence and rebrand rationale","Confirmed program name and rules for its relationship to the parent brand","Audience and persona definitions, including advisor and client segments","Channel, asset and format inventory with dimensions, quantities and launch phases","Approved product claims, mandatory disclosures and legal or regulatory requirements","Source copy and ownership of copywriting, translation, transcreation and proofreading","Required French locale and selected Chinese language, script and regional variants","Accessibility, privacy, data and document-retention requirements","Print specifications, vendors, budgets, schedules and distribution markets","Stakeholder roles, approval authority and review cadence","Baseline advisor awareness or adoption data and measurable launch targets"],"assumptions":["The parent financial-services identity remains authoritative and the program will be adapted into it rather than replaced by an unrelated standalone brand.","The engagement includes campaign strategy and a scalable communications system, not changes to the underlying managed-portfolios product.","English and French are required across the agreed core asset set, while Chinese-language delivery applies only to a client-approved subset of print materials.","Professional translators, regional reviewers and legal or compliance stakeholders will validate all localized financial-services content.","Any logo-system work concerns the program-to-parent relationship, naming and lockups and does not imply redesigning the parent-brand logo.","Final asset quantities, channels and production specifications will be confirmed during intake."],"stop_conditions":["Do not select a creative direction without explicit client approval and confirmation of the program naming architecture.","Do not finalize messaging or localized layouts until product claims, mandatory disclosures and source-language copy are approved by authorized legal or compliance reviewers.","Do not produce French or Chinese masters without confirmed locale or script requirements and qualified linguistic review.","Do not expand the system across assets until the audience matrix, channel inventory and required language coverage are approved.","Do not release print-ready files without final dimensions, printer specifications, proof approval and validated fonts or image rights.","Do not deliver launch assets until all required brand, accessibility, legal, compliance and localization approvals are recorded."],"rationale":"This is primarily an adaptation and launch assignment: an established offering must be brought into a parent identity, expressed through an audience-specific campaign and scaled across multilingual communications. The workflow therefore moves from strategic and localization definition through explicit concept selection, identity governance, asset expansion and controlled production handoff.","confidence":0.91}
